name: Soldier
desc: Fights. Attacks enemies that come close.
notes: The barracks trains it from early on; iron gates it naturally because iron needs a mine. An army eats: 1 wheat per soldier per upkeep interval.

name: Archer
desc: Shoots from four hexes away. Fragile up close.
notes: Trained at the archery range. No projectile yet: hits land at range like a long reach. Model: Ranger from the Adventurers pack later.

name: Knight
desc: Heavy cavalry from the castle. Hits hard and takes a beating.
notes: Only the castle trains it, so it needs Feudalism and the whole chain below. Eats double. Model: Knight from the Adventurers pack later.
